name: Expensify
summary: Expensify charges $5 a member each month on its Collect plan, with no annual commitment, for accounts created on or after April 1, 2025. The Control plan costs $9 to $36 an active member, depending on term and whether the Expensify Card carries half of US spend.

facts.text: Collect covers unlimited SmartScans, expense approvals and next-day ACH reimbursement.
Receipt requirements and amount flags need the Control plan, while Collect gets only a few rules such as required fields.
On Control, an active member is anyone who creates, submits, approves, reimburses or exports reports in the month.
The $9 Control rate needs an annual subscription and the Expensify Card for 50% or more of settled US spending in the month.
Expensify says it is free for individuals and offers a 30-day free trial for companies.
The mileage page says trips can be tracked with GPS, entered as start and stop addresses on a map, logged from an odometer photo, or entered as total distance.
Admins can set custom mileage rates by employee group, role or project, or use the IRS mileage rate, according to the mileage page.
Mileage expenses route into an expense report with category, tags and descriptions, and the mileage page says reports can be exported for tax season.

plans.name: Collect
plans.notes: Month to month with no annual contract. Applies to accounts whose first workspace was created on or after April 1, 2025; earlier accounts keep the older structure

plans.name: Control, annual with Expensify Card
plans.notes: Needs an annual term and the Expensify Card for 50% or more of settled US spending

plans.name: Control, annual without card use
plans.notes: Annual term; users above the committed number cost $36 a month each

hiddenCosts: Annual Control subscriptions can add users at any time but can reduce them only after the term ends.
